name: Meridian Synthesis Group
description: A mid-tier independent studio operating under a Vantablack sub-licensing agreement that grants them production rights in exchange for right-of-first-refusal on any property that exceeds a certain viewership threshold. MSG produces genre entertainment — crime drama, political thriller, and speculative fiction — that is commercially successful enough to make Vantablack's acquisition interest a permanent background pressure. The studio's leadership has spent twenty-three years threading the needle between creative autonomy and commercial survival.
cultural_impact: Demonstrated the structural trap of sub-licensing agreements, inadvertently becoming a cautionary tale that radicalized a generation of independent producers toward either full underground operation or full corporate absorption.
story_hooks: MSG's creative director is secretly developing a property off the books, outside the sub-licensing agreement, and needs it produced and distributed before Vantablack discovers it exists
The acquisition of MSG's flagship property in 2218 was not entirely legal — someone has documentation
An MSG production is being used as cover for something else entirely, and the studio's leadership may not know it
